sanskrit_verse:
मृषायुक्ति क्रियाहीनमसाध्याद्यर्थमाकुलम् ।
पूर्वं पक्षं लेख्यतो वादहानिः प्रजायते ॥२०॥
transliteration: mṛṣāyukti kriyāhīnam asādhyādyartham ākulam | pūrvaṃ pakṣaṃ lekhyato vādahāniḥ prajāyate || 20 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When argumentation is false, action is absent, the matter is unsolvable, or the mind is agitated, and when one records a biased preliminary stance, the loss of rightful discourse arises.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from clarity of intent, not positional dominance
Causation is traced to distortion in foundational cognition
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with truth-functional reasoning
Restoration logic demands removal of prejudicial pre-writing in judicial process
Consciousness alignment necessitates abandoning agitation-induced bias
executable_legal_axioms: IF argument contains mṛṣā (falsehood) THEN disqualify speaker from proceeding until realignment
IF no causal action (kriyāhīna) THEN case suspended pending capacity verification
IF subject is unsolvable (asādhya) THEN refer to meta-judicial review board
IF mental agitation (ākula) detected THEN initiate consciousness stabilization protocol before continuation
IF prior bias recorded (pūrvaṃ pakṣaṃ lekhyataḥ) THEN nullify current session and restart without prejudice
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any indication of prejudicial positioning by counsel or judge results in automatic suspension of proceedings. Truth-value integrity must be verified at entry points; failure to maintain it invalidates all subsequent actions. Agitation or unresolved cognitive conflict mandates mandatory consciousness recalibration prior to resumption.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies falsehood and agitation as root causes of defective judgment. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how early distortion propagates systemic error. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring clarity rather than assigning blame. The non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction occurs through conscious re-alignment, not punitive measures.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pramāṇa-realignment session for involved parties
Deploy śuddhi-krama (purification sequence) to remove agitation traces
Reconstruct dialogue framework sans prior assumptions
Assign śikṣaka (consciousness guide) to stabilize participant cognition
Verify renewed capacity for impartial engagement before proceeding
final_declaration: Thus declared by Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma. Falsehood distorts law; agitation clouds judgment. True justice emerges only when consciousness is purified and aligned. There is no punishment—only completion. Reality responds to clarity, not coercion. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
